test_title: PYST 28: SSC CGL 2025 Tier-I Similar Paper - English (Held On: 21th Sep 2025 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Convert to direct speech:

The mentor stated that the student had continued even after his theories were repeatedly disproved.

options.text: The mentor said, “The student had continued though his theories are disproved.”
The mentor said, “The student continued even after his theories were repeatedly disproved.”
The mentor remarked, “The student had continued even after his theories were repeatedly disproved.”
The mentor said, “The student continues though theories were disproved.”

solution:
The correct answer is '2' i.e. **The mentor said, “The student continued even after his theories were repeatedly disproved.”**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is reported speech written in the past perfect tense: "The mentor stated that the student had continued even after his theories were repeatedly disproved."
 
• The task is to convert this into direct speech, ensuring proper tense (past tense) and phrasing.
 
• In direct speech, the exact words of the speaker are quoted, and the pronouns and tenses must align with the context.
 
• Option 2 is correct because it accurately converts the sentence into direct speech while maintaining the context of the statement.

Correct sentence: *The mentor remarked, “The mentor said, “The student continued even after his theories were repeatedly disproved.”*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Reported Speech to Direct Speech Conversion Rules:**

 
 
• Remove reporting verbs like "stated," "remarked," or "said" and replace them with direct quotes.
 
• Ensure tense consistency. If the reporting verb is in the past tense, maintain past tenses inside the direct speech.
 
• Use quotation marks to enclose the exact words of the speaker.
 
 
 
• **Example:**
 
 
• Reported Speech: She said that she was tired.
 
• Direct Speech: She said, "I was tired."
